A selection of what I'm working on now. I keep two GitHub accounts. My work for NOAA's Northeast Fisheries Science Center is done under my work account, [MGrezlik](https://github.com/MGrezlik), and much of it lives in the Ecosystem Dynamics and Assessment Branch organization, [NOAA-EDAB](https://github.com/NOAA-EDAB). This website and my personal and past research projects live on my personal account, [MaxGrezlik](https://github.com/MaxGrezlik).

## Current work

::: {.project-grid}

::: {.project-card}
### State of the Ecosystem

I automate and maintain several of the ecosystem indicators in the annual State of the Ecosystem reports for the New England and Mid-Atlantic Fishery Management Councils, which give managers a yearly summary of ecosystem conditions.

[ecodata](https://github.com/NOAA-EDAB/ecodata) · [NEFMC report](https://github.com/NOAA-EDAB/SOE-NEFMC) · [MAFMC report](https://github.com/NOAA-EDAB/SOE-MAFMC) · [Technical docs](https://github.com/NOAA-EDAB/tech-doc)
:::

::: {.project-card}
### Thermal habitat suitability indicator

For the New England Fishery Management Council's Risk Policy, I developed an indicator of thermal habitat suitability that tracks how ocean temperatures are changing the habitat available to managed species. It will appear in this year's State of the Ecosystem report.

[In development]{.card-tag}
:::

:::

## R packages I maintain

::: {.project-grid}

::: {.project-card}
### Rpath

An R implementation of the Ecopath with Ecosim food web model, used to build mass-balance ecosystem models and simulate them over time. My work includes fitting Rsim, its dynamic simulation component, to observed time series.

[Documentation](https://noaa-edab.github.io/Rpath/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/NOAA-EDAB/Rpath)
:::

::: {.project-card}
### survdat

Pulls and processes data from the NEFSC bottom trawl surveys, with tools for calculating stratified means and other survey-based indices.

[Documentation](https://noaa-edab.github.io/survdat/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/NOAA-EDAB/survdat)
:::

::: {.project-card}
### comlandr

Pulls and processes commercial fishery landings data for the Northeast US, preparing them for use in assessments and ecosystem models.

[Documentation](https://noaa-edab.github.io/comlandr/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/NOAA-EDAB/comlandr)
:::

:::
